entries.6164fd863929485a: This business manufactures, supplies and sells city gas, and sells and maintains gas appliances. Gas sales volume for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 1,644 million m3 for residential use (△0.9% year on year), 4,916 million m3 for commercial and other use (△1.5%), and 6,560 million m3 in total (△1.4%). Revenue for this reportable segment is not separately printed in the securities report.
entries.69ba75f6ee167f04: This reportable segment centers on the manufacture, supply and sale of city gas, and covers gas appliance sales, gas piping work at customers' premises, sale and transport of ＬＮＧ (liquefied natural gas), ＬＰＧ sales, industrial gas sales, and power generation and electricity sales. Revenue is the largest of the segments, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,639,494 million. Revenue including internal transactions, as cited in management's analysis, fell ¥94.4 billion (△5.4%) from the previous year to ¥1.6434 trillion, mainly due to a lower gas sales unit price under the raw material cost adjustment system. Gas sales volume for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 6,560 million m3, and the number of gas supply contracts was 5,161 thousand. The number of low-voltage electricity supply contracts was 1,946 thousand. In January 2026, Unit 1 of the Himeji Natural Gas Power Plant (generation capacity of approximately 620,000 kW) began commercial operation, and in May 2026, Unit 2 also began commercial operation. The gas pipeline business is handled by subsidiaries such as Osaka Gas Network Co., Ltd., sales to residential customers by Osaka Gas Marketing Co., Ltd., and sales to commercial and other customers by Daigas Energy Co., Ltd.
